title: 第一卷 第26章 什么狗屁贵人，什么狗屁律条！
content_zh:
陈昭宁眉宇间满是忧色：“可……若是不敌该如何收场？”

    “呵。”

    陈渊冷笑一声，“尽力一战，若真不敌，再抽身脱离便是。”

    “路见不平若不敢出手，心中郁结难舒，又何以与天地争锋、与大道竞逐？”

    听闻这番铿锵话语，陈昭宁缓缓眯起眼眸。

    她望着眼前少年，美目之中烈焰熊熊，心绪激荡！

    “少年当有少年狂，不负年少意气长！”陈渊说罢，转头看向李伟。

    “对，干他妈的！！”

    李伟低声应和，面色激动得涨红。

    无人察觉，他整只手掌已然化作鎏金之色。

    与此同时，门外围观指点的人越聚越多。

    酒馆内其余食客皆是满脸兴奋，等着看一场好戏。

    “呵，三个不知天高地厚的蠢货。”

    “全无尊卑礼数，奴仆之流竟敢与贵人同席而坐，还敢无端惹事？”

    ······

    酒馆食客议论纷纷。

    恰在这时，有人望见人群中走来几道身影，顿时脸色煞白。

    “天呐！怀山县县丞大人来了！”

    “怎么不见县守大人？”

    “对付两个毛头小子，何须县守大人亲自出面？未免太抬举他们了！”

    “倒也是，县守大人可是黄庭道人！”

    “听闻县守大人已率领麾下强者，外出追缉执剑余孽去了。”

    “原来如此，难怪只有县丞前来。”

    ······

    众人神色惊呼起来，脸色微变。

    来者正是怀山县二把手，县丞黄得来。

    “黄大人亲自到场，可见怀山柳家的声势何等显赫！”

    “何止黄县丞？还有无相门小队队长杨灵也来了！

    啧啧，那身段，胸大屁股翘的，恐怕轻轻一捏，就能掐出水来。”

    “她自然要来，顶头上司本就是柳公子之父。”

    “连酒馆老板何连正也赶来了，这场热闹，怕是越闹越大了。”

    ……

    酒馆食客的低语，尽数落入陈渊耳中。
content_en:
Chen Zhaoning's eyebrows were full of worry: "But... what will happen if we lose?"

"Heh."

Chen Yuan sneered, "Fight with all your strength. If you really lose, just get away."

“If you don’t dare to take action when you see an uneven road, and your heart is filled with depression, how can you compete with heaven and earth, and compete with the great road?”

After hearing these sonorous words, Chen Zhaoning slowly narrowed his eyes.

She looked at the young man in front of her, with blazing flames in her beautiful eyes, and her heart was agitated!

"Young people should be wild and live up to their youthful spirit!" After Chen Yuan said this, he turned to look at Li Wei.

"Yeah, fuck it!!"

Li Wei responded in a low voice, his face flushed with excitement.

No one noticed that his entire palm had turned into a gilded color.

At the same time, more and more people gathered outside the door to watch and give advice.

The other diners in the tavern were all excited, waiting to see a good show.

"Oh, three idiots who don't know the heights of the world."

"With no respect or etiquette at all, servants dare to sit at the same table with nobles, and dare to cause trouble for no reason?"

······

The diners in the tavern were talking a lot.

Just at this moment, someone saw a few figures walking in the crowd, and his face suddenly turned pale.

"Oh my God! The magistrate of Huaishan County is here!"

"Why don't you see the magistrate?"

"Why do we need the county governor to personally come forward to deal with these two idiots? It would be too flattering to them!"

"Indeed, the county magistrate is Taoist Huang Ting!"

"I heard that the county governor has led his strong men to go out to hunt down the remaining sword-wielding villains."

"I see. No wonder only the county magistrate came."

······

Everyone looked shocked and their expressions changed slightly.

The person who came was none other than the second-in-command of Huaishan County, the county magistrate Huang Delai.

"Master Huang is here in person, which shows how prominent the Huaishan Liu family is!"

"Not only Huang County Cheng? Yang Ling, the captain of the Wuxiang Sect team, is also here!

Tsk tsk, that figure, with big breasts and a perky butt, I'm afraid you can squeeze out water with just a pinch."

"Of course she wants to come. Her immediate boss is Mr. Liu's father."

"Even the tavern owner He Lianzheng has arrived. I'm afraid the excitement will get bigger and bigger."

…

The whispers of the diners in the tavern fell into Chen Yuan's ears.
